description.text: The second enhanced expansion pack of the Sword & Shield series, released on 24 April 2020, which joined some cards of Rebellion Crash with new Pokémon VMAX: Centiskorch VMAX, whose attack grows with its Fire Energy, Gardevoir VMAX, which heals itself as it attacks, and Butterfree VMAX. Vikavolt V, Grapploct V and Galarian Stunfisk V join them, with the Supporters Kabu and Pokémon Breeder's Nurturing. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 70, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon V and Supporters, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon VMAX and Supporters, and gold Ultra Rare Rillaboom, Suspicious Food Tin and Big Parasol. In English most of its cards came out in Darkness Ablaze in August 2020.
